content: कुम्भकः .²1 The base of a column (used especially in this sense frequently in inscriptions). .²2 A religious exercise (in Yoga <ab>phil.</ab>), stopping the breath by closing the mouth and both nostrils with the fingers of the right hand; प्राणापानौ संनिरुन्ध्यात्पूरकुम्भकरेचकैः <ls>Bhāg. 7. 15. 32</ls>.
